people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
translations.bsb: He has remembered His love and faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
translations.kjv: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
translations.asv: He hath remembered his lovingkindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel: All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
